content.text: Skip to main content Fuels Valero Produces Liquid Transportation Fuels and Other Products Transportation fuels, petrochemical feedstocks and other specialty products that are essential to modern life Leader in Fuels Production 3.2 million barrels per day throughput capacity (processing of crude oil and other feedstocks) 12 Ethanol plants: combined production capacity of 1.7 billion gallons per year 1.2 billion gallons per year of renewable diesel production capacity Up to 235 million gallons per year of neat SAF production capacity Leader in Fuels Production Valero has refineries located in the United States, Canada and the United Kingdom, and we sell liquid transportation fuels and specialty products globally. Gasoline Valero offers customers and partners quality gasoline, including TOP TIER™ certified fuel. /refining/fuels/branded-valero Diesel Valero provides high-quality diesel fuel products. We also are America’s largest producer of renewable diesel. /renewables Jet Fuel Valero is a global leader in the production and marketing of commercial, industrial and military grades of jet fuel. We also are one of the world's largest producers of neat SAF. Ethanol Valero produces ethanol and distillers’ grains feed products at 12 Valero ethanol plants in the U.S. /renewables/ethanol Global Leaders Valero is dedicated to safety, excellence and accountability at all times.
